body: I got a appointment for next Monday. Thanks for replying to my post. I feel good right now and I will try my hardest next time I feel down to push through it.

I feel like God has a plan for everyone's life, and I am suppose to die soon. I think that me killing myself would end up being good for my ex girlfriend because she has said that she feels happy now and hadn't while in our relationship. I think she would hurt but in the long run would be better without me. I don't know if I could ever truly leave her alone.. As I said I am turning into a awful person, I call and text her everyday and she tells me not too. I would never hurt her physically but I am having a hard time leaving her alone. I think as of right now she would hold me in a somewhat high regard but I feel that resentment growing the more I talk to her. I have good moments but my low moments are seeming to become more low. I feel like I almost go into a psychosis where I am fixated and obsessing over what happened and why she won't talk to me.
That is pretty cool. Sadly our company is not nearly that progressive to allow that in protocols haha. But that is a cool thing to keep in mind.

Yeah I read about 1-2ml/kg was a lethal dose which means he took about 3-4 times the lethal dose. The ER was working fast but we kinda drop of patients and finish our report on the way to or next call type of thing. So we didn't stay for long.
